Installed, but not connected?

Use this page in the Chrome profile where geoplonk is installed. Install or update to v0.3.11 or later, reload the extension at chrome://extensions, and then reload this page. Older builds cannot connect to the website.

Games still run locally through the extension; the website does not receive your guesses, location trail or statistics.
